messages:
nina: quick sync - wrapping up internal announce for v5.2.1. need final blurb + pinned artifact. planning to schedule the blast T-10 before canary. can we do a deploy-bot dry-run so docs + oncall see exact text?
ryan: blurb draft: 'v5.2.1: smarter request batching to improve tail latency. No API changes; backward compatible.' two lines.
kelly: please include the pinned artifact string for Dedicated customers. i'll add to the account-reps note.
marcos: pinned: serve-runtime@v5.2.1 (sha: b7f2e1). also propose rollback rule: rollback to v5.2.0 if 5m error rate > 0.9% or p95 latency +45% over 5m.
nina: ok add that. also let's make the canary conservative: 15m canary in us-west, then ramp to 40% over 10m.
ryan: can we have an initial alert adjustment instead of muting? oncall prefers raised thresholds for first 8m.
oncall: yes - we can raise error threshold to 1.2% and p95 delta to +60% for the first 8m window. won't silence, just reduce noise.
kelly: @deploy-bot run staging dry-run for thread 9725557777 so i can paste exact phrasing into the release notes doc.
deploy-bot: staging dry-run started for thread 9725557777. emitting [DRY-RUN] messages that mirror prod. ETA ~90s.
deploy-bot: dry-run output:
- "[DRY-RUN] Release v5.2.1 scheduled. Canary: us-west 15m -> ramp to 40% over 10m. Pin: serve-runtime@v5.2.1 (b7f2e1)"
- "Rollback policy: 5m error rate > 0.9% OR p95 latency increases > 45% -> rollback to v5.2.0"
- "Initial alert adjustment: error_rate threshold -> 1.2% for first 8m; latency p95 delta threshold -> +60% for first 8m"
- "Owners: nina (release), kelly (docs & accounts), marcos (deploy), oncall (pager)"
nina: great. add blackout: avoid EU midnight 23:00-02:00 UTC for the canary. that's in the deploy config.
marcos: pasted config snippet for docs appendix: ```
canary: { region: "us-west", duration: "15m" }
ramp: { to: "40%", duration: "10m" }
blackout: { region: "eu", start: "23:00Z", end: "02:00Z" }
alerts: { initial_adjust: { error_rate: "1.2%", p95_delta: "+60%", window: "8m" } }
pin: "serve-runtime@v5.2.1 (b7f2e1)"
rollback: "to v5.2.0 if 5m error_rate > 0.9% OR p95 +45% for 5m"
```
ryan: i'll fold the snippet into the internal note and add a short account-rep callout about Dedicated pinning.
kelly: who will post the internal blast? need it T-10.
nina: ryan, can you post and pin?
ryan: yep. scheduling for 2024-07-01T16:50:00Z (T-10). i'll tag owners and accounts list.
oncall: once posted i'll validate the pager thresholds reflect the 'initial_adjust' values.
nina: thanks. small copy edit: change 'No API changes' -> 'No API changes; backwards-compatible' (s).
ryan: done. final blurb: 'v5.2.1: smarter request batching to improve tail latency. No API changes; backwards-compatible.'
marcos: deploy configs staged. i'll flip to prod at T. leaving thread open for last-minute edits. :rocket:
